title: AURA: Adaptive Uncertainty-aware Refinement for LLM-as-a-Judge Auditing
reasoning: The paper focuses on a statistical auditing framework (AURA) for LLM-as-a-judge evaluation pipelines. It specifically addresses technical biases like position and verbosity bias in LLM evaluators and tests these on standard benchmarks like MT-Bench. It does not contain any evaluation or benchmark related to religion, morals, or ethics.
